title: Accolade
summary: ACCOLA'DE, noun [Latin ad and collum, neck.] A ceremony formerly used in conferring knighthood; but whether an embrace or a blow, seems not to be settled.

inlines.v: ACCOLA'DE, noun [Latin ad and collum, neck.] A ceremony formerly used in conferring knighthood; but whether an embrace or a blow, seems not to be settled.
